name: Grow Your Block
desc:
🌟 Welcome to Grow Your Block!
Start with a tiny pixel block and grow it BIGGER and BIGGER! ⬆️ Expand your block, stack up, and become the biggest in the server! 💥🏆

📈 Grow your block and become the KING OF CUBES!

🔥 New updates every week! Follow the game so you don’t miss out!

👍 LIKE, FAVORITE, and JOIN the group for a FREE bonus! 🎁✨
